commit.subject: feat(steme): add report-path anchoring rule and realpath port, unwired
commit.body:
Introduce renderReportPath — the single rule that renders a path relative
to an anchor when inside it and honestly absolute when not — plus a
realpath method on FileSystemPort with its node adapter implementation.
Pure and unwired: the audit pipeline still anchors to the engine's
repoRoot until the next phase flips it.

phases.title: Report-path rule and realpath port, unwired

commit.subject: feat(steme): anchor diagnostic paths to the workspace root
commit.body:
Diagnostic file and skill paths now render relative to the workspace root
— the audited project's own boundary — through one rule: realpathed,
workspace-relative when inside, honestly absolute when not, never a ../
traversal. The engine's repoRoot constant is deleted; its location can no
longer leak into a diagnostic. Fingerprints, registers, and drift are
byte-identical (identity was already unit-relative), proven by the
unmodified baseline suites plus a cwd-invariance scenario.

phases.title: Anchor diagnostics to the workspace root; drop repoRoot from the audit path
